Groupe détenu et dirigé par des associés, Pictet propose une gamme complète de services financiers destinés à des familles et à des particuliers fortunés, comprenant des solutions de gestion discrétionnaire et de conseil en placement ainsi que des services de family office.

Au sein du département PWM Risk & Control Functions, en votre qualité de Business Compliance Manager, vous analyserez tous les nouveaux dossiers d’ouverture de compte de la clientèle.

Your role

• Analyser les dossiers liés aux ouvertures de comptes, tant sur le plan matériel (PEP, Close to PEP, High Risk, Medium Risk & Low Risk) que sur les aspects formels et fiscaux (FATCA, CRS, etc.).

• Rédiger des documents de synthèse concernant les demandes d’ouverture de comptes et les présenter aux différentes instances de la Banque.

• Conseiller les gérants, notamment sur le processus d’ouverture de compte.

• Veiller au respect des réglementations (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB), notamment dans le cadre de la lutte contre le blanchiment d’argent et le financement du terrorisme (AML).

Your profile

• Expérience d’au moins 5 ans à un poste similaire dans une banque privée en Suisse.

• Formation universitaire ou bancaire ; un certificat en compliance management est un atout.

• Intérêt marqué pour les aspects liés à la réglementation, en particulier dans le domaine de l’AML. Très bonne connaissance de la LBA, de l’OBA-FINMA et de la Convention de diligence des banques, ainsi que de sa jurisprudence.

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels, notamment le logiciel bancaire Avaloq et MS Office.

• Français et anglais courants ; la maîtrise d’une autre langue est un atout.

• Domicile en Suisse requis.

Rigoureux/se, intègre et discret/ète, tout en étant doté/e d’un esprit curieux et d’un réel sens du service à la clientèle, vous savez faire preuve d’initiative et d’engagement. Vous montrez un intérêt marqué pour tous les aspects réglementaires et êtes capable de faire respecter et appliquer la réglementation ainsi que les directives internes de manière stricte, tout en plaçant la satisfaction du business au cœur de vos priorités. Organisé/e et méthodique, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et contribuez, par votre attitude, à maintenir un excellent climat de travail.

All'interno del dipartimento Risk & Control Functions di PWM, in qualità di Business Compliance Manager, analizzerai tutti i nuovi file di apertura dei conti cliente.

Il tuo ruolo

- Analizzare le pratiche relative alle aperture di conto, sia a livello materiale (PEP, Close to PEP, Alto Rischio, Medio Rischio e Basso Rischio) che su aspetti formali e fiscali (FATCA, CRS, ecc.).

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) is a company that is based on a Swiss bank legacy of over two hundred years and on international expertise in investment. Pictet is a group owned and run by partners and offers a comprehensive range of financial services for for families and forsaken individuals, including discretionary management and investment consulting solutions as well as Family Office services.

In the PWM Risk & Control Functions department, as Business Compliance Manager, you will analyze all new client account opening files.

Your job

- To analyse the files relating to the opening of accounts, both in terms of materiality (PEP, Close to Tweet, High Risk, Medium Risk & Low Risk) and on the formal and fiscal aspects (FATCA, CRS, etc.). - To draft consolidated documents concerning requests for opening accounts and to present them to the various bodies of the Bank. - To advise managers, in particular on the process of opening accounts. - To ensure compliance with regulations (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CBD), particularly in the context of the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism (AML).

Your profile

- Experience of at least 5 years in a similar position in a private bank in Switzerland. - University or banking training; a certificate in compliance management is an asset. - Interest in regulatory aspects, particularly in the field of AML. Very good knowledge of the LBA, the OBA-FINMA and the Banking Due Diligence Convention, as well as its jurisprudence. - Mastery of the usual computer tools, including Avaloq and MS Office banking software. - Current English and French; mastering another language is an asset.

Ihr Team

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) stützt sich sowohl auf eine mehr als zweihundertjährige Schweizer Banktradition als auch auf internationale Anlageexpertise. Pictet ist eine von Partnern geführte und verwaltete Gruppe und bietet ein umfassendes Spektrum an Finanzdienstleistungen für Familien und vermögende Privatpersonen, einschließlich diskretionärer Verwaltungs- und Anlageberatungslösungen sowie Family-Office-Dienstleistungen.

Innerhalb der Abteilung „PWM Risk & Control Functions“ analysieren Sie in Ihrer Funktion als Business Compliance Manager alle Dateien zur Eröffnung neuer Kundenkonten.

Deine Rolle

- Analysieren Sie Dateien im Zusammenhang mit Kontoeröffnungen, sowohl auf materieller Ebene (PEP, Close to PEP, High Risk, Medium Risk & Low Risk) als auch auf formaler und steuerlicher Ebene (FATCA, CRS usw.).
- Verfassen Sie zusammenfassende Dokumente zu Kontoeröffnungsanträgen und legen Sie diese den verschiedenen Bankbehörden vor.
- Beratung von Managern, insbesondere beim Kontoeröffnungsprozess.
- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Vorschriften (AML, OBA-FINMA, VSB), insbesondere im Kampf gegen Geldwäsche und Terrorismusfinanzierung (AML).

Ihr Profil

- Erfahrung von mindestens 5 Jahren in einer ähnlichen Position in einer Privatbank in der Schweiz.
- Universitäts- oder Bankausbildung; Ein Zertifikat im Compliance Management ist von Vorteil.
- Starkes Interesse an regulatorischen Aspekten, insbesondere im Bereich AML. Sehr gute Kenntnisse des GwG, der VBA-FINMA und des Banksorgfaltsübereinkommens sowie deren Rechtsprechung.
- Beherrschung gängiger IT-Tools, einschließlich Avaloq-Banking-Software und MS Office.
- Fließendes Französisch und Englisch; Fließende Kenntnisse einer weiteren Sprache sind von Vorteil.
- Wohnsitz in der Schweiz erforderlich.
- Sie sind streng, ehrlich und diskret, haben einen neugierigen Geist und ein echtes Gespür für den Kundenservice und wissen, wie Sie Initiative und Engagement zeigen.
- Sie zeigen ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an allen regulatorischen Aspekten und sind in der Lage, Vorschriften und interne Richtlinien strikt durchzusetzen und anzuwenden, wobei Sie die Geschäftszufriedenheit in den Mittelpunkt Ihrer Prioritäten stellen.
- Sie sind organisiert und methodisch, schätzen Teamarbeit und tragen durch Ihre Einstellung dazu bei, ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima aufrechtzuerhalten.

Ref

BCMO/SN/CH

Hinweis

Wir akzeptieren keine Lebensläufe über Agenturen

Vielfalt und Inklusion

Pictet setzt sich als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit ein und setzt sich für die Schaffung eines vielfältigen Umfelds ein. Wir respektieren jeden Einzelnen und streben nach seiner Einbeziehung am Arbeitsplatz.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking to recruit a Client Relationship Officer to strengthen our Luxembourg-based team. The Client Relationship Officer will be responsible for all operational dimensions of daily banking activities with the aim to deliver a world-class client experience by ensuring front operational excellence.

Your role

• Be the point of entry for all operational requests from bankers or clients

• Process payments and transfers while ensuring call backs are systematically performed and support for other transactional activity where needed

• Ensure telephone call coverage is in place in the team

• Place orders on the market or perform 4-eyes on orders other placed

• Secure strict follow-up of client documentation

• Administer the end-to-end account-opening process, taking into consideration local regulatory specificities

• Procure KYC information and update complementary documents in the systems.

• Process workflow requests in the systems (client codifications, credit card requests, credit lines, pricing exceptions, etc.)

• Adjust to all existing policies and directives and support the implementation of new ones, where needed

• Build close relationships with relevant internal stakeholders

• Support assistance with administrative tasks when required

• Ensure a close follow-up of all your tasks

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor’s degree or similar relevant qualification

• Minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar function, in a private bank

• A definite interest in financial markets and current international affairs

• Familiarity with banking regulation, tax and, AML and KYC is an asset

Soft skills:

• Strong team spirit and open-minded

• Attention to detail

• Able to work independently and diligently with a strong sense of responsibility

• Reliable, flexible and resilient, and the ability to multi-task

• Service and solutions oriented and proactive mindset

Language skills:

• Fluent in English

• Fluent in Swedish or Danish

• French is a plus

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato in 30 sedi in centri finanziari in tutto il mondo, e attualmente impiega oltre 5200 persone. Pictet è presente dal 1989 a Lussemburgo, dove occupa oltre 700 persone.

Pictet Wealth Management combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà dei partner offre un servizio completo per persone ricche e famiglie, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

Stiamo cercando di reclutare un responsabile delle relazioni con i clienti per rafforzare la nostra squadra lussemburghese. Il Customer Relationship Officer sarà responsabile di tutte le dimensioni operative delle attività bancarie quotidiane con l'obiettivo di offrire un'esperienza cliente di livello mondiale garantendo l'eccellenza operativa anteriore.

Il tuo ruolo

• Essere il punto di ingresso per tutte le richieste operative da parte di banchieri o clienti

• I pagamenti di processo e i trasferimenti, assicurando che i richiami siano sistematicamente eseguiti e il supporto per altre attività transazionali laddove necessario

• Assicurare la copertura delle chiamate telefoniche è in vigore nel team

• Posizionare gli ordini sul mercato o eseguire 4 occhi su ordini altri piazzati

• Controllo sicuro della documentazione del cliente

• Amministrare il processo di apertura del conto end-to-end, tenendo conto delle specificità normative locali

• Procure informazioni KYC e aggiornare documenti complementari nei sistemi.

• Le richieste del flusso di lavoro di processo nei sistemi (codifiche dei clienti, richieste della carta di credito, linee di credito, eccezioni di prezzo, ecc.)

• Adeguare tutte le politiche e le direttive esistenti e sostenere l'attuazione di nuove, laddove necessario

• Costruire relazioni strette con gli stakeholder interni rilevanti

• Assistenza di supporto ai compiti amministrativi quando necessario

• Assicurare un follow-up ravvicinato di tutti i vostri compiti

Il tuo profilo

Esperienza richiesta:

• Corso di laurea o simile qualifica rilevante

• Minimo da 2 a 3 anni di esperienza in una funzione simile, in una banca privata

• Un certo interesse per i mercati finanziari e gli affari internazionali attuali

• Familiarità con la regolamentazione bancaria, fiscale e, AML e KYC è un bene

Morbide competenze:

• Forte spirito di squadra e mentalità aperta

• Attenzione al dettaglio

• In grado di lavorare in modo indipendente e diligente con un forte senso di responsabilità

• Affidabile, flessibile e resiliente, e la capacità di multi-task

• Servizio e soluzioni orientate e proattive

Capacità linguistiche:

• Fluente in inglese

• Fluente in svedese o danese

• Il francese è un plus

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV da agenzie.

Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, i candidati possono essere tenuti a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale. Questo documento, rilasciato dalle autorità, non deve essere più vecchio di tre mesi. Tale documento sarà richiesto con l'obiettivo di effettuare un controllo del carattere sui candidati, tenendo presente l'area di attività del nostro stabilimento e, più in particolare, i compiti descritti nella descrizione del lavoro.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a specific focus on Technology, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors. You will report to a senior analyst responsible for Technology research and investments.

Your role

• Assisting the senior Technology equity research analyst covering the Technology sector.
• Taking over some of the existing coverage of the Technology sector.
• Expanding existing coverage of the Technology sector.

• Building and maintaining complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Conducting management interviews, attending conferences, and interacting with sell side analysts.
• Designing and deploying AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate and improve idea generation and fundamental research.

• Sourcing and researching investment ideas to be invested in the Technology portfolio.
• Publishing investment content on internal and external platforms.
• Making stock recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
• Participating in marketing and servicing activities for internal and external stakeholders.

.

Your profile

• University degree: ideally Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• A minimum of 5 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, in the Technology sector. Prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.
• Native or equivalent written and spoken English, fluent or better written and spoken French.

• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative (but not quant) skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.
• Outstanding written communication skills (investment memos, research notes) and excellent presentation skills to convey complex ideas clearly and convincingly.

• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg (terminal and Excel API), Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; solid working knowledge of VBA.
• Confident and effective user of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude and similar applications) to enhance research productivity, insight generation and workflow efficiency.

• Independent-minded, intuitive, self-starter personality with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Ability to work under pressure and to meet demanding deadlines.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Applications for candidates without the minimum required experience in the Technology will not be considered and will be rejected automatically. Bloomberg, Excel, VBA, and other specific skills will be tested and evaluated specifically, in writing.

• Prendendo in esame una parte della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.
• Ampliamento della copertura esistente del settore tecnologico.

• Condurre colloqui di gestione, partecipare a conferenze, e interagire con gli analisti laterali di vendita.
• Progettazione e distribuzione di strumenti e flussi di lavoro basati su AI per accelerare e migliorare la generazione di idee e la ricerca fondamentale.

• Pubblicazione di contenuti di investimento su piattaforme interne ed esterne.

• Partecipazione alle attività di marketing e assistenza per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

.
